scope.reason: The prior CPU Smoke stopped during RSPMM extension loading. A later offline diagnostic in the same pinned environment successfully imported the CPU RSPMM extension, loaded the frozen 34,640,897-parameter G-reasoner checkpoint, and placed the model on CPU without reading task data. This single bounded recovery tests whether the unchanged 5-unit ranker Smoke can now execute.
unchanged: graph construction, scoring, seed, metrics, thresholds, and stop rules
scope.supersedes: The stopped amendment_003_cpu run remains closed and its run ID is not reused; this amendment uses new run IDs and a separate output directory.
scope.model_review: The user's model-review choice remains honored as secondary proxy analysis. The existing Qwen A/B Smoke agreement was 2/5, below its 4/5 gate, so reviewer Full remains stopped. SQL-derived labels for the primary rank comparison do not depend on reviewer consensus.

stopping.smoke: Run one 5-unit invocation. Require finite scores for every candidate and complete candidate coverage. Any failure closes this recovery; do not retry on CPU.
stopping.full: Run once on the fixed 108 units only if Smoke passes and its observed CPU/wall time projects below the registered 900 CPU-second, 1,800 wall-second, and 8 GiB RSS caps. Stop on any cap, missing/non-finite score, or incomplete candidate coverage.
